title: Giấc ngủ sâu
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): deep sleep, the stillest: the darkest pad, a deep sub and a faint far choir, the chords changing only every few breaths, nothing else; about seven minutes. D minor at 42 bpm. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
